Alex: Morning team — quick check-in. SLO rollup noisy 03:10–03:40 UTC. Two pages: model-proxy 5xx spike, gpu-pool tail latency. What I did: rolled back canary 2026-03-16T22:45Z, restarted 2 nodes in gpu-pool, collected flamegraphs for proxy.

Priya: Thanks. Any concrete signal for proxy? 5xx rate or specific endpoint?

Alex: 5xx rate ~4.8% for /v1/generate over 30m, retries spiked too. Logs show transient OOMs in proxy container. Saved logs here: https://logs.redwood.internal/entries/abc123

Marco: @Alex can you paste the alert rule? I want to check threshold.

Alex: Sure:
```
alert: ModelProxy5xxHigh
expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{handler="/v1/generate",status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (instance) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{handler="/v1/generate"}[5m])) > 0.03
for: 5m
```

Priya: That's the old rule — we forgot to lower the window after we added retry buffering. Suggest bump to 0.05 and add an annotation with runbook link.

Jen: FYI OncallBot auto-created incident INC-348 for the 5xx spike.

OncallBot: Incident INC-348 opened, priority P2, assigned to eng-sre-oncall.

Sam: I checked gpu-pool — tail latency occurred during a burst of long-context jobs. One host had degraded NVLINK performance; restarted SR-2100 process.

Emily: I updated the canary config to cap batch size for long-context jobs. Rolling that to canary v3 now.

DeployBot: Canary v3 rollout started for gpu-pool-canary (10%).

Marco: Quick asks — (1) @Priya can you update alert rule and add suppression for during rolling deployments? (2) @Sam please add NVLINK host to hardware watchlist. (3) @Jen please confirm incident notes include fallback to model-v2.

Priya: On it — will push rule change and add annotation. ETA 30m.

Sam: Added host to hw-watchlist and created ticket TKT-556. ETA for deeper hardware triage tomorrow.

Jen: Adding incident note about fallback. Also pinging Platform on rollback automation follow-up.

Alex: Blockers: need one more +1 on rule change from @Marco before I apply. Otherwise OK. I'll follow up later with SLO burn dashboard screenshot.

Marco: +1. Go ahead.

Alex: Applying change now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
